requirement: Every certified viz capability has at least one governed deterministic gallery example
notes: Network-free fixture or small simulated cube.

requirement: Every candidate is visually inspected by a named human reviewer before certification
Scientific data tests object contract tests and visual regression tests remain separate
Manifest records function style renderer dataset variable purpose script output dimensions and review
Static representative formats include PNG plus SVG or PDF where suitable
notes: Journal sizing DPI fonts and transparency reviewed.

requirement: Interactive examples use bounded self-contained or dependency-declared HTML
notes: Avoid enormous embedded payloads and remote tiles.

requirement: Animation examples use short previews representative frames or compressed MP4
notes: Do not commit large frame sets.

requirement: 3-D examples include a deterministic screenshot and optional bounded HTML
Default per-file soft limits are PNG/SVG/PDF 2 MiB HTML 5 MiB GIF 5 MiB MP4 10 MiB
notes: Larger artifacts require explicit review and generated-on-demand preference.

requirement: Gallery outputs record provenance QA and source-semantics context
notes: Visual review must detect raw-versus-field ambiguity.
